financial-10k-ingestion-powerbi.label: 📈 Financial extraction
financial-10k-ingestion-powerbi.latestCommit:
Add 10-K ingestion pipeline, data explorer and Power BI dashboard

Extracts text, tables and images from Apple/Microsoft/Tesla 10-K PDFs into
Postgres (tables + financial facts), JSONL + local embeddings (RAG) and image
files. Includes a Flask console to run ingestion and a Data Explorer page,
statement-based fact extraction with fiscal-year detection, SQL views for
Power BI, and the Power BI report with its DAX measures.
